parts.name: Leg (Left Temple Arm)
parts.Basic_description: This is the left leg (temple arm) of the eyeglasses, made of polycarbonate plastic. It is a long, narrow component extending from the frame to the ear.
parts.Functional_description: It provides support and stability by resting on the ear, keeping the eyeglasses in place during use.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate around the hinge joint to fold inward for compact storage or open outward to fit on the head.

parts.name: Leg (Right Temple Arm)
parts.Basic_description: This is the right leg (temple arm) of the eyeglasses, made of polycarbonate plastic. It mirrors the left leg in shape and function.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the eyeglasses on the opposite side of the head, ensuring balance and comfort.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate around the hinge joint to fold inward or open outward, similar to the left leg.

parts.name: Base Body (Frame and Lens Assembly)
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the eyeglasses, including the frame and lenses. The frame is made of polycarbonate, and the lenses are made of acrylic.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the lenses in position and provides the main structure for the eyeglasses. The lenses correct or protect vision, while the frame ensures proper alignment on the face.
parts.Movement_description: The base body itself is rigid and does not move, but it connects to the legs via hinges that allow folding.
